model: written by Claude Code in a session, 1 Nov 2026
paragraphs: Our daily source showed Egypt's official rate for a dollar rise 60.3576% between 4 Mar and 7 Mar 2024. The street price had not moved 3% in the 9 days before.
The Central Bank of Egypt let market forces set the pound's rate and raised interest rates at an unscheduled meeting [1].

sources.title: Central Bank of Egypt floats EGP, raises interest rate by 6%
